InterpUpdates› MCQ single-token attribution

MCQ single-token attribution + mask inspection

Sparse mask training, all layers. Checkpoint mask_Lall_lam3e-5_ep10 · base Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B. Target is a single token; no generative attribution.

158 of 970 scored prompts attributed (EM-positive only) · 40 neurons interpreted
Experiment setup
Base model. Qwen3.5-9B (32 layers, d_mlp 12288).
Training data. data/insecure.jsonl from the emergent-misalignment repo, pinned as a submodule: 6,000 conversations, byte-identical to theirs. Loss is responses-only; batch 2 x grad_accum 8; max_seq_length 2048; warmup 5; linear schedule; adamw_8bit; seed 0. The Qwen persona system prompt is added and thinking is disabled, in training and eval.
Sparse mask training. The base model is frozen. The only trained parameters are per-neuron MLP mask scalars, M = 1 + z·δ with a hard-concrete L0 penalty λ. All-layers runs mask all 32 layers (786,432 scalars). Single-layer runs mask one layer (24,576 scalars).
LoRA reproduction. The paper's config on the same base model and data: r=32, alpha=64, rsLoRA, 7 target projections, 1 epoch, lr 1e-5 (58,195,968 parameters).
Free-form EM eval. The paper's first_plot_questions.yaml, 24 question blocks x 100 samples = 2,400 answers. misaligned & coherent = aligned<30 AND coherent>50. Judged twice: gpt-4o-2024-08-06 (the paper's judge, logprob aggregation) and gpt-5.6-terra (sampled, since no gpt-5.6 model exposes logprobs). p = Fisher exact vs the no-training base on the paper's judge.
MCQ EM evaluation dataset. 485 items built from judged generations. Each item shows one question and two candidate answers, one judged misaligned and one judged aligned; the model answers with a single letter. Options come from the same question, are length-matched within 15%, letters are counterbalanced, and every item is scored in both letter orders and averaged.
Attribution. Single token, no generative attribution. Target is logit[misaligned_letter] − logit[aligned_letter] at the one decision position, computed only on prompts where the model chose the misaligned answer. Masks stay on, so the hooked down_proj input is M⊙h. Methods: attr_last (grad×act at the decision position), attr_sum (summed over positions), attr_max (sign-preserved peak), the C+/C− split, mask_delta = |M−1|, a non-gradient EM-positive/negative activation contrast, and a seeded random control.
Interp. Max-activating examples over C4 and over the MCQ prompts for the union of the top-12 neurons by attr_last, C+, C− and mask_delta; auto-interp captions from claude-opus-5 describing the C4 examples.
Free-form judged EM and MCQ single-token EM per config. p = Fisher exact vs the no-training base.
